Sometime after [[200,000 BBY]], two cults&mdash;the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] sisterhood known as the [[Warriors of Shadow]] and the [[Death/Legends|death]] cult [[Knell of Muspilli]]&mdash;'''battled''' each other in a terrible [[Space warfare/Legends|naval battle]] above a [[Unidentified moon (Unknown Regions)|unnamed]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The battle site was discovered tens of thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]; many of the cults' derelict [[Starship/Legends|starships]] remained at the site.<ref name="Battle of Terror" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle between the two cults was first mentioned in the Archaeology crewskill "Battle of Terror" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Battle of Terror" />
